Name: Aimon's Farmhouse Rooms (PIF)
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#fff2cc][size=3][i]Ever wished to have more custom farmhouse rooms? With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]﻿﻿ you now have a full set of them![/i][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]
This mod adds 3 new rooms - balcony, attic and rooftop which will expand in size with every farmhouse upgrades. You can also dig floors in balcony and use it as greenhouse.
Those are rooms from my two farmhouse mod ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Tidy Cozy[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14411]Fancy Farmhouse[/url]) - now you can have same rooms even with other custom farmhoue mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17526]Lnh's FarmHouse[/url]![/size][/font][/center]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Config:[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][b]Balcony Recolor[/b] - Elegant, Rustic Country Town (Dark/White), Starblue, Vibrant Pastoral[/size][/font]
[/list]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Compatibility:[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Compatible with expansions such as SVE, RSV, etc...[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Compatible with recolors[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]---------------------------------
[b][color=#ffe599]NOTE[/color][/b] - for balcony you'll need to choose recolor in my mod's config (since those are my custom tilesheets)

[b][color=#ffe599]NOTE[/color][/b]- if you want to recolor rooftop - you'll have to do it manually:
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Go to my mod's  "[CP] [PIF] Aimon's Farmhouse Additions - Rooftops,Attics&Balcony\assets\Tilesheets" folder[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Find folder named "For Rooftop Recolor"[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Open it, in there you'll find image tilesheet files for the rooftop (I included Aseprite, Paint.net and separated .png file formats)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Edit your desired parts of the rooftop with any preferred image editor (change hue/saturation, etc...)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Save the changes in those files, make sure for the files to have names like "Aimon_Rooftops.png", "Aimon_Rooftops_spring.png", etc...[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Copy your edited files and put them in "[CP] [PIF] Aimon's Farmhouse Additions - Rooftops,Attics&Balcony\assets\Tilesheets" folder.[/size][/font]
[/list][/size][/font][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]
Installation:[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url].[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Unzip [i]"[CP] [PIF] Aimon's Farmhouse Additions - Rooftops,Attics&Balcony" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]Have fun![/size][/font]
[/list]
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#fff2cc][size=3]How to get the doors:[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]For PIF doors - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]read PIF mod description[/url].[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2]There's also 3 new "door" furniture type which you can buy in Robin's shop - attic ladder, rooftop ladder and balcony door.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b][color=#d9ead3][size=3]Credits:[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]That gorgeous balcony door is a texture from  [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4258]DTANADAWTNARW[/url] mod made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5727458]spacesheepcaptain[/url], go check it out![/size]
﻿
[/font][center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]-----------------------------------------[/size][/font][/center]
